en.flavor: A ceremonial greatsword that has become petrified over time. The trinkets on it are still visible. It grants the wielder the power to withstand the winds of time.

refinements.1: After damaging an opponent with an Elemental Skill, the skill has a <r>40%</r> chance to end its own CD. Can only occur once every <r>30</r>s.

fr.flavor: Un espadon ornemental que le temps a pétrifié, mais dont les ornements sont toujours visibles. Cette arme confère à son possesseur le pouvoir d'affronter les vents du temps.
